failure: Unicode hyphens shredded dates into fake hallucinations
observed: Three of six reviewer notes were withheld citing ungrounded numbers '06', '09', '05'. All three notes were entirely faithful: the model wrote dates with a non-breaking hyphen (2023‑06‑01), which the number scanner split into fragments with no source.
why_it_matters: A grounding check that accuses correct notes of hallucinating is worse than no check. Reviewers learn to ignore the flag, and the one real hallucination goes out with the rest.
correction: Typographic dashes and spaces are normalised before scanning, and dates are matched as whole units against the context's dates rather than as three independent numbers.

failure: Dates in the record were never grounded at all
observed: One note was withheld for quoting the loan's own origination date, 2023-06-01, which was in the supplied context.
why_it_matters: The context builder collected numbers and strings but silently ignored pandas Timestamps, so every date in every record grounded nothing. Any note quoting a date it was given was liable to be blocked.
correction: Timestamps are grounded as their ISO date, their year-month and their year.

failure: A range was read as a negative number
observed: A probe response was flagged for the ungrounded figure '-5'. It came from the model echoing this pipeline's own instruction, 'a short reviewer note (3-5 sentences)'.
why_it_matters: The control was reporting the pipeline's own prompt back as a hallucination.
correction: A hyphen preceded by a digit is a dash, not a minus, and the prompt's own numbers are part of the grounded set.
